card.name: Cirrhosis complications: ascites and varices
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small linking words right around cirrhosis complication terms such as ascites, variceal bleeding, encephalopathy and decompensation, mostly in lists of liver events or Child-Pugh text.

modes.label: Between listed complications
modes.description: A comma or 'and' separating ascites, variceal bleeding and encephalopathy in a list of decompensation events.

modes.label: Linking words near liver severity terms
modes.description: A small word such as 'of', 'with', 'to' or an opening bracket just before or after ascites, varices or Child-Pugh grades.
modes.example: decompensated cirrhosis<< (>>Child-Pugh B or C) Led

card.writes: Little clear output; it mildly favors odd tokens such as '门' (portal) and 'Child', echoing portal hypertension and Child-Pugh.
card.plain: It lights up on the small words and commas around cirrhosis complications like ascites and bleeding varices.
